The resolver answered registered. Continue stays shut and the

The resolver answered reserved (internal, trademark or
community). Reserved names are not sold here.
The resolver or its [names] section did not answer. The buyer

The ceiling: plus is off at ten. Minus is off at two, as on N2.
Six letters cost four times the base: $200 a year, $600 for
three years. Seven cost twice, $100 a year.

a second order, which would be a second charge. An unpaid

Storage is full or refused. The code is shown once, and copying
it is the only way to keep it.
The code was made in the buying browser and the service holds
only its hash, so support can confirm the payment by its

Design document, not screenshots of a build: every web screen is rendered from mockups/screens.js on the webapp's own compiled modules and styles.css, so the shared screens are the real ones and the name screens are prototypes for nameScreens.ts.
A name code is an entitlement - names of N or more letters for Y years. It is not bound to the name that was checked, because registering needs the owner's wallet key, which only the app has.
The name leaves the page only on Check availability. The service hashes it for the resolver and neither logs nor stores it; checkout carries the tier, the years and the code's hash, never the name.
Prices: $50 a year for 8 or more letters, twice that for 7, four times for 6; 2 to 10 years, paid once, nothing renews.
Regenerate after npm run build in apps/simplex-badge-service/web with: node plans/names-codes/mockups/board.mjs
